entities.name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure using EAP-AKA' that enables mutual authentication between UE and network and generates key material.

entities.name: EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message
entities.description: Authentication challenge message sent by the network during EAP-AKA' procedure.

entities.name: USIM present
entities.description: Condition that a USIM must be present in the UE for proceeding with EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message.

entities.name: CK
entities.description: Cipher Key generated by USIM during successful EAP authentication, used as key material.

entities.name: IK
entities.description: Integrity Key generated by USIM during successful EAP authentication, used as key material.

entities.name: EMSK or MSK generation
entities.description: Process where ME uses CK and IK as key material to generate EMSK or MSK.

relations.description: EAP based primary authentication procedure involves EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message exchange.
UE proceeds with EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message only if USIM is present.
Successful EAP authentication procedure results in CK generation by USIM.
Successful EAP authentication procedure results in IK generation by USIM.
CK is used as key material for EMSK or MSK generation.
IK is used as key material for EMSK or MSK generation.
